name: applauncher-sigstub
description: Stock-vs-patched AppLauncher .sign verification A/B on the startup-group preload path: the stock launcher must refuse a signature-corrupted official binary (CheckSign ret = 0) and an unsigned marker script (readSection elf_begin fail) while passing a good-signature ApplicationManager preload; the patched launcher (FUN_00115b50/FUN_00112100 stubbed to mov eax,1; ret) must preload the good-signature manager, spawn both unsigned and bad-signature binaries and the functionally-intact bad-signature AppDMClient must still register its bus name. Real launcher/manager/client, synthetic groups, micom and software graphics; on-demand skip flag, rendering and stock boot equivalence remain unverified.

conformance: Requires the signature-verification-bypass launcher (crypto bypass); conformance forbids application/crypto substitutions.
